lines.cap: No phone, no map? You can make a compass from a needle.
lines.say: No phone, no map? You can make a compass from a needle.

lines.cap: Take a sewing needle and a magnet.
lines.say: Take a sewing needle and a magnet.

lines.cap: Stroke the needle along the magnet, in one direction only, about thirty times.
lines.say: Stroke the needle along the magnet, in one direction only, about thirty times.

lines.cap: Inside the steel, tiny magnetic regions start to line up.
lines.say: Inside the steel, tiny magnetic regions start to line up.

lines.cap: Now the needle is a weak magnet. It can even lift a pin.
lines.say: Now the needle is a weak magnet. It can even lift a pin.

lines.cap: Push it through a thin slice of cork.
lines.say: Push it through a thin slice of cork.

lines.cap: Float the cork in a bowl of still water.
lines.say: Float the cork in a bowl of still water.

lines.cap: Slowly, it turns. One end points north.
lines.say: Slowly, it turns. One end points north.

lines.cap: Because the Earth itself is a giant magnet, and your needle lines up with it.
lines.say: Because the Earth itself is a giant magnet, and your needle lines up with it.

lines.cap: Check it once against the sunset, mark the north end, and you will never be lost again.
lines.say: Check it once against the sunset, mark the north end, and you will never be lost again.
